newsitem.title: USA: Motorola unit, Alcatel in supply pact.
newsitem.headline: Motorola unit, Alcatel in supply pact.

text.p: Motorola Inc said its Cellular Infrastructure Group signed a distribution agreement with a unit of Alcatel Alsthom Cie Generale d'Electricite' covering a variety of telecommunications products.
The companies said the agreement will allow both partners to distribute the other's cellular and fixed radio systems, mobile switching centers and transmission equipment.
Financial terms of the pact were not announced.
Motorola manufactures telecommunications equipment, semiconductors and advanced electronics systems.
Its shares were trading down 1/8 Tuesday at 63-1/8.
